Mutation "texel chosen by the sampler instead of the shader": it can only change a kept pixel whose texel distance to a boundary lies in [2^-10, 2^-8) texel (8 sub-texel bits of Direct3D 11). Measured: the column "kept in [2^-10, 2^-8)" above is 0 for every case and factor (the smallest kept distance is the "min texel distance kept" column), so no probe can see that mutation; it is closed by design (the shader picks the texel, G2b1-R6), not by a threshold.
